quote_caption_ru:
"I no longer call you slaves, for a slave does not know what his master is doing;

but I have called you friends, because I have told you all that I have heard from my Father. You didn't choose Me, I chose you." – Jesus Christ
quote_caption_en: "I no longer call you slaves, for a slave does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, because I have told you all that I have heard from my Father. You didn't choose Me, I chose you." – Jesus Christ
script_ru: Я больше не называю вас рабами, потому что раб не знает, что делает его господин; но я назвал вас друзьями, потому что сказал вам все, что слышал от Отца моего. Вы не избрали Меня, но Я избрал вас.
script_en: I no longer call you slaves, for a slave does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, because I have told you all that I have heard from my Father. You didn't choose Me, I chose you.
